highlights: Explore cities like Helsinki and Geilo, then cruise through scenic waters, admiring the beauty and culture of Scandinavia and Finland.
Enjoy a Skyview Gondola ride and admire the picturesque views of Stockholm from 130-meters above sea level.
Capture the beautiful landscapes of Norway with the "Norway in a Nutshell" tour, featuring fjords, a scenic train journey, and a cruise.
Visit Oslo's famous landmarks, including the Vigeland Sculpture Park, Kon-Tiki Museum, and the iconic Oslo Opera House.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each guest at the time of arrival.
Each Scandinavian country and Finland has its currency (Swedish krona, Norwegian krone, Danish krone, Euro). Carry local currency for convenience.
Do not consume alcoholic beverages or drugs, if you are found intoxicated, you might be asked to leave the premises of attractions.
Scandinavia and Finland are among the most environmentally conscious regions in the world, so make sure you give importance to sustainable travel practices.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Helsinki | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Helsinki! Upon your arrival at the airport, you'll be driven to the hotel. After you check in, relax for some time. Later, you can explore the city at your own pace. Explore Esplanadi Park, a green oasis known for strolling. Admire world-class Finnish art at the Ateneum, Finland's premier art museum. Also, visit Sibelius Park to see the Sibelius Monument and Kallio Church, an architectural gem offering views of Helsinki. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Helsinki Sightseeing Tour | Helsinki to Stockholm Cruise
days.desc: Check out and get driven for the Helsinki sightseeing tour. During this exploration, discover Helsinki Cathedral’s neoclassical architecture and admire Finlandia Hall's modernist design. Also, visit City Hall to see its elegant interiors, explore the Parliament House's grand chambers and get driven to the Presidential Palace's stately facade, among other spots. Later, get transferred to the Helsinki Pier to board the Silja Line cruise to Oslo. Have an overnight stay on board.

items.title: Stay at Tallink Silja Line, Stockholm

days.title: Stockholm Sightseeing Tour | Skyview Gondola Ride | Visit to Vasa Museum
days.desc: As you reach Stockholm, disembark from the cruise. From the Stockholm Pier, get driven for a city tour. During the tour, visit Stockholm City Hall to see its stunning architecture and the historic main square of Gamla Stan, Stockholm’s charming Old Town, among other spots. Then, get driven to Skyview, for a gondola ride to enjoy views of the city. Moreover, explore the Vasa Museum to see a well-preserved 17th-century warship. Post tour, get driven to the hotel and check in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Stay at Good Morning+ Hägersten, Stockholm

days.title: Transfer to Bergen | Bryggen Hanseatic Wharf Tour | Visit to Mount Floyen
days.desc: Check out from your hotel and get driven to the airport for your flight to Bergen (tickets not included). On arrival, enjoy a guided tour of Bryggen Wharf, a UNESCO World Heritage site known for its colourful wooden buildings and rich maritime history. Next, take a scenic funicular ride to Mount Fløyen for breathtaking panoramic views of Bergen and its fjords. After that, you'll be driven to the hotel. Upon arrival, check in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Stay at Comfort Hotel Bergen Airport

days.title: Norway in a Nutshell Tour | Transfer to Geilo
days.desc: After you check out from the hotel, get transfer to Gudvangen for the Norway in a Nutshell tour. Start with a scenic fjord cruise from Gudvangen to Flåm, enjoying breathtaking views of Nærøyfjord. As you arrival, Flåm, take the Flåm Railway for a picturesque train ride to Myrdal. From Myrdal, continue your journey to Geilo. Upon your arrival, check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Stay at Thon Hotel Hallingdal, Geilo

days.title: Transfer to Oslo | Oslo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After check-out, you'll be transferred to Oslo. Upon arrival, start a sightseeing tour visiting Vigeland Sculpture Park and the Kon-Tiki Museum. Explore Vigeland's impressive sculptures and learn about Thor Heyerdahl's Pacific voyage at the Kon-Tiki Museum. Next, enjoy a guided tour of the Oslo Opera House, appreciating its modern design and panoramic views. Finally, you'll be transferred to Oslo. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Oslo Sightseeing Tour | Cruise from Oslo to Copenhagen
days.desc: Check-out and get transferred for a sightseeing tour of Oslo. See famous places like City Hall, National Theatre, Norwegian Parliament, and Grand Hotel. Later, get assisted to the port for a cruise to Copenhagen. Have an overnight stay on board.

items.title: Oslo Sightseeing Tour with City Hall

days.title: Arrival in Copenhagen | Copenhagen Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Upon arrival, get transferred from the port in Copenhagen for a sightseeing tour. Visit attractions like Danish Parliament, the Little Mermaid, and more. Later, get assisted to Tivoli Gardens, the oldest amusement park of the city. Then, get assisted to the hotel and check-in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After breakfast, pack your bags and check-out from the hotel. Get transferred to the airport for a flight back home. This is where your trip comes to an end.
